name: Facilities Maintenance Technician
summary:
The Immerse Learn Facilities Maintenance Technician VR application provides immersive, hands-on training in a realistic virtual environment. Designed as a component of the Immerse Learn Facilities Maintenance Technician certification program, the application allows enrolled students to practice essential facilities maintenance procedures, tools, equipment, safety practices, and workplace skills through interactive VR simulations.
